'''High-output ion turbines''' were a type of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They increased the speed of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] but had a bad reliability. Models included [[Girodyne/Legends|Girodyne's]] [[Ter40 high-output ion turbine]], [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems's]] [[SFS-220 ion drive]] and [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[R800 ion ramjet]].
